channel.title: The Flight of the Koalas
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "The Flight of the Koalas" - A tale about the emergency evacuation of koalas using flying serpents.

item.title: Re: The Flight of the Koalas
item.content:encoded:
Summoned via PM:

Hi there Veralta. Let’s take a look at your concept.

+ LBL
- LBL

Wilpena Pound

This might not be as well known a place to people outside Australia. You might want to add a clarifier after?

Sightings of "flying serpents" are to be quickly verified and acted upon.

“acted upon” is slightly vague. Do you want to give a more specific hint so we can understand the anomaly a little better?

The Foundation History Department is mandated to research texts and information

The tense here is a little inconsistent when compared to the previous sentences. I would remove “is mandated to” and simply put “will” to keep with the clinical tone.

to collect pertinent information.

Again, being specific in the conprocs goes a long way. What kind of information should the Foundation look out for? This adds to our understanding of the scp in the long run.

during 2022

Sounds a little off. You would say “during a year”, but not a specific one. Would change to “in 2022”.

two years after severe bushland fires within the region

Missing an “occurred” after “fires”.

Compiled data indicates a severe decline in population density, upwards of nearly 2,000 per week.

Nitpick, but the second part of this sentence doesn’t link to the first. “2,000” refers to the actual number, not the population density.

It is to be noted that the surviving koala population at this point numbered approximately 62,000.

The past tense of “numbered” indicates that the Foundation is writing from a place of the future? Sorry, just wanted to clarify.

Additionally, testimonies from zoos across and outside the continent indicate that their koalas have also disappeared, despite all efforts to contain or track them.

This was slightly confusing to read. Do you just mean “internationally” or “globally”?

Uluru, Wilpena Pound, Black Mountain2, Arnhem Land, and the Grampian National Park.

Again, these might be entirely foreign terms for those not familiar with Australian Geography. You might want to add qualifiers like “near Sydney” or in “New South Wales”.

Heavy rainfall would occur in tandem

Tenses need to be more consistent, I think. You’re switching between present and future perfect tense, which muddies the viewer’s sense of time.

as SCP-5870 continuously occurs.

A little awkward. You mean to say “at the rate SCP-5870 continues to occur”?

The 2020 bushfires had burned 24 percent of the eucalyptus trees, while approximately 60,000 koalas have been recorded as casualties. 84 percent of survivors have severe burns on their paws, while 31 percent had suffered from dehydration and starvation.

I’m not sure this entire section should be under the “Description” section, as it’s additional context for the anomaly, and not about the anomaly itself. You could re-classify this section as your Discovery log.

SCP-5870-1 instances, despite numerous

“being numerous”.

share striking similaries.

“similarities”. And also, similarities to what? Each other?

bullroarers

Second occurrence of a foreign term without additional context.

These were subsequently fed by the entities to arriving SCP-5870-1 instances

This is happening quite fast, making it hard to keep track of who is who. “These” meaning the nuts? “the entities” here refer to the koalas? I would break up the description and add a little more detail for pacing.

After five minutes, they flew at high speeds

Indicate direction?

which would then hold onto them

“hold” => “cling”. Might want to also specify which parts of the snakes they hold onto.

where a large levitating island, referred to as SCP-5870-2, was discovered.

Whoa, whoa. Why wasn’t this noticed before?

It is to be noted that 40 percent of the island's surface is composed of a lake.

I would remove the “It is to be noted” as this is not something particularly noteworthy.

They then reach a small lake, wherein the main dome is located at its center.

This is confusing. Is the small lake located at the center of the dome? Or is the main dome at the center?

Some of the koala groups make their way to the smaller domes, which are not located in the the lake.

I thought they were deposited at the smaller domes first? “the” is repeated.

koalas living onto them

Unclear what you mean here.

as they are spectated by other koalas.

“as” meaning “because” they are spectated? Meaning unclear.

It is notably

“notably” -> “notable”.

dyed white and yellow.

Again, why is this noteworthy?

The koalas enter the dome.

I thought we were already inside the main dome. Best to clarify earlier where the drone footage starts, and where we’re headed.

manipulated in get fleshy materials

Sorry? Is there a typo here?

After it leaves the SCP-5870-2 duplicate at Mount Warning, SCP-5870-3 has collected approximately 5,600 more koalas.

The sentence structure here is convoluted. Meaning unclear.

the Foundation has listed koalas as critically endangered

Ah? Are we in a Broken Masquerade scenario? Why is the Foundation assuring the public?

Overall, I enjoyed this exploration log, though I felt it went on a little too long and didn’t understand the significance of certain events (like the koalas and kangeroos fighting). You might also want to clarify the description to make it clear what we’re seeing, when.

mitigated these through engineering solutions.

“these” refers to? If it’s the flooding, then the tense should be changed.

10 percent of its national budget to it

“it” refers to?

approximately 115.31 million tons

tonnes of what?

35 Small Modular Reactors14.

The footnote should come after the period.

the TIMES magazine

Do you mean “Time Magazine”?

Closely cooperating with aboriginal groups such as Bundjalung, Eora, and Gamilaaray, greenery restoration programs in New South Wales and Queensland have also been successful

The subject of the sentence is not clear – who is the one “closely cooperating”?

Foundation task forces quickly mobilize. Fortunately, most Australians were celebrating the New Year inside their homes.

I don’t see the link between both sentences?

turn over a new leaf

Personally, this is a highly cliqued phrase, though I can’t say much else if it’s officially a part of lore. Consider rephrasing to simply “turn over” or “turn themselves over” to get the same effect.

+ Overall
- Overall

1. Is the pacing and narrative good enough?

Well, yeah. It was a wild ride. I’m not familiar with Aboriginal culture (like, at all), and seeing these stories come to life was eye-opening. I just hoped to understand their significance a little more. You’ve clearly done our research and included many references to the culture and origin stories. The main issue (if it really is one in the first place) is outsiders like me don’t really see the significance of the minute events / symbols / objects.

I do like the overarching narrative though of nature taking climate change into its own hands. It’s a strong and relevant message. My major concern would be the deemphasis here on the Foundation’s role in the entire article. Basically, we’re just left as bystanders throughout the entire event, right? Which is fine if that’s what you’re going for, but removes any agency and tension from the narrative.

2. Is the worldbuilding and attention to detail decent and palatable?

Yup, as mentioned above, A good amount of detail included. Just needs to be further explained and the description clarified (who, where and when we are).

3. Does it sound too preachy?

Nope. I think the lesson is clear but not overbearing.

4. If applicable, have you noticed several problems and contradictions with Dreamtime lore and aboriginal beliefs?2

Perhaps I don’t understand the lore and beliefs in the first place. You could be more explicit in this regard, for example, providing an actual story or myth at the beginning, besides just the stone carving.

I also wasn’t clear throughout how the aboriginal community fit into the scp. There’s a passing reference to them creating posters to create awareness, but where do they fit into the story? Wouldn’t it be cool if you could show them being facilitators / active defenders of the entities as the anomalies occur. But again, I don’t want to prescribe a cultural stance for them.

Overall, I’m tending towards an up-vote. The writing is mostly clear, as are the notes and themes you seek to hit.

Thanks for sharing this with us!

item.title: The Flight of the Koalas
item.content:encoded:
Word Count: 2,371

Link: http://scpdsandbox.wikidot.com/veraltanic-page-3-0

Hello everyone! This is Veralta once again completing a draft that I hope to publish as a New Year's gift! I have written a social commentary about koalas, how they and the aboriginal Australians have been affected by the bushland fires, and how people should be more ecologically-minded. I also featured a trip throughout Australia's rich culture and locations, with several of the article's parts being based on Dreamtime1 lore.

Note: I have tried to make the parts of the article that I have based on Dreamtime to be as least abstract as possible, and clear. If there are questions or ambiguity that you can find about them, feel free to mention it in the critique!

Here are the points that I want to be reviewed:

1. Is the pacing and narrative good enough?
2. Is the worldbuilding and attention to detail decent and palatable?
3. Does it sound too preachy?
4. If applicable, have you noticed several problems and contradictions with Dreamtime lore and aboriginal beliefs?2

All in all, I hope you enjoy this SCP in time for the New Year (and a new leaf for all of us)! Thank you to those who will review this!

Footnotes
1. Umbrella term for aboriginal Australian beliefs.
2. I have researched this part as much as possible, so I would like to not screw up something here.
